conf.description: Exchange mailbox-audit / api-pull: Search-MailboxAuditLog / New-MailboxAuditLogSearch collector objects, already field-split PascalCase (assumed JSON via ConvertTo-Json, matching the message-tracking pull transport's collection pattern) - rename+transform, dedup on Identity across overlapping search windows.

conf.comment: exchange / mailbox-audit / api-pull. Per recommendations.direct.cribl: shape collector output to ECS, handle OperationResult's PartiallySucceeded explicitly (no ECS equivalent), and dedup on the audit entry Identity because a pull source has no file-position checkpoint. host.name stamping and MailboxOwnerUPN lookup enrichment are called for in the recommendation but need collector-specific context / a lookup table this map does not supply - left as documented gaps, not guessed.

functions.description: record parsing approach and the two gaps carried from recommendations.direct.cribl
parse the collector's JSON-serialized audit entry into fields
dedup on the audit entry Identity across overlapping Search-MailboxAuditLog windows, per recommendations.direct.cribl; Identity is not a mapped field row but is the schema's own record key
event time to Cribl's canonical _time (never @timestamp directly)
split the semi-structured ClientInfoString into a client component and an action component per its notes; raw string is kept too since the grammar is only semi-structured
batch rename every clean-identifier mapped/partial/unmapped field to its ECS or microsoft.exchange.* target

OperationResult to event.outcome with PartiallySucceeded folded to unknown (no ECS equivalent) while the original three-value distinction is preserved in a custom field, per recommendations.direct.cribl
tag dataset and drop _raw now that every value is field-extracted
